descriptions.leftover-provider-tokens: Clears the tokens a sign-in provider gave Adiutor when a sign-in with it didn’t finish.
descriptions.finished-sign-ins-as-users: Ends the sign-ins as a user whose time is up, and records it in the audit log.
descriptions.expired-sign-in-data: Deletes expired sign-in links, codes and sessions, and rate limits that are over.
descriptions.invitation-reminders: Reminds people of invitations they haven’t accepted, once, two days before they expire.
descriptions.retention: Deletes audit events after a year, errors after 7 days, and the history of jobs after 30 days.
descriptions.security-notice: Tells people about changes to the security of their account.
descriptions.added-to-company: Tells people that staff added them to a company.
descriptions.staff-admin-added: Tells the staff Admins that someone became a staff Admin.

summary.ended: {count, plural, one {# sign-in as a user ended} other {# sign-ins as a user ended}}

summary.sessions: {count, plural, one {# session deleted} other {# sessions deleted}}
summary.rateLimits: {count, plural, one {# rate limit deleted} other {# rate limits deleted}}
summary.auditEvents: {count, plural, one {# audit event deleted} other {# audit events deleted}}
